description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractNamespaceCommandResponse that provides a base implementation for namespace-related command responses within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It manages namespace and resource type information, and includes methods for JSON payload representation, equality, and hashing.

classes.name: AbstractNamespaceCommandResponse
classes.description: An abstract base class for namespace command responses, providing common functionality such as namespace and resource type management, JSON payload construction, and equality checks.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace associated with this response.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the namespace as the identifier of this response.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns an EntityId object representing the namespace.

methods.name: getResourceType
methods.description: Returns the resource type associated with this response.

methods.name: getResourcePath
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer path for the resource, defaulting to an empty pointer.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks for equality between this response and another object.

methods.name: canEqual
methods.description: Helper method for equality checking, confirming if the other object is an instance of the same class.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the object state.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Appends the namespace and resource type fields to the provided JSON object builder according to a schema.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the object's namespace and resource type.
